title: The Drowned Cousin
text: A cousin of the House, drowned ten years ago and buried with honor, is at the gate this morning, dripping, asking to come home. They remember everything. They are a little too cold.

outcomes.text: They take up their old room and their old sword, and train harder than any of the recruits.
They take up their old room. Within a month the well water tastes of the river, and the House's eldest sleeps in a chair by the fire.

options.label: Test them with silver and salt.

outcomes.text: They hold the silver without flinching. They are only cold. They stay.
The silver burns them. They go back to the river without a word, and the House mourns them twice.
They stand at the gate until dark, and then they are not there. The family plot is wet for a year.
